 WTA Guangzhou Day 2 Predictions Including Dayana Yastremska vs Katie Volynets 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 WTA Guangzhou is well and truly underway, with day two in China seeing the conclusion of the first round, with players looking to earn some positive results and valuable ranking points near the end of the season. Full crowds should be expected given the packed slate of matches and, as ever, we here at LWOT will be offering our predictions for every match, including Venus Williams vs Lilli Tagger and Sofia Kenin vs Kaitlin Quevedo .  But who do you think will advance?
 WTA Guangzhou Day 2 Predictions
 Antonia Ruzic vs Claire Liu
 Head-to-head: first meeting
 This matchup will be an intriguing battle between two aggressive baseliners, as both Antonia Ruzic and Claire Liu like to dictate play from the back of the court, using their aggressive mindset to look to end points rather than building out longer rallies. Ruzic is still the better scrambler of the two in defensive situations, while Liu is the better server. On the faster hard courts at WTA Guangzhou, Liu’s serve might very well be the deciding factor in what should be a competitive match.
 Prediction: Liu in 3 
 Zeynep Sonmez vs Sara Sorribes Tormo
 Head-to-head: Sorribes Tormo 1-0 Sonmez
 The only other time these two players faced off against each other, Sara Sorribes Tormo swept away Zeynep Sonmez, dropping just two games. But now at WTA Guangzhou where their rivalry will be resumed, the players are at different stages of their careers, with Sonmez improving and Sorribes Tormo having not yet rediscovered her level of tennis since her comeback to the tour. In a match that will be played predominantly from the back of the court, expect Sonmez’s more aggressive play and counterpunching to come out on top.
 Prediction: Sonmez in 2 
 Dayana Yastremska vs Katie Volynets
 Head-to-head: Yastremska 1-1 Volynets
 This matchup pits Katie Volynets’ more defensive style of play against the uber-aggressive and high-variance style of Dayana Yastremska. Yastremska did well in the qualifying round, adjusting herself well to the court conditions, something that can prove to be really valuable for a player who relies on positive rhythm from the baseline. While Volynets does have the playstyle to frustrate Yastremska into making unforced errors, on the faster hard courts at WTA Guangzhou, the Ukrainian should have the edge in conditions that suit her.
 Prediction: Yastremska in 3
